title: Lumen Metabolism Reading Daily Event Volume
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lumen:metabolism
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(measurement_time) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Lumen metabolism reading events land each day and how many distinct time of day values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Lumen metabolism reading records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct time of day values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It follows how much Lumen metabolism reading activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
